message:
I had a hilarious moment during our last power outage that left me both chuckling and a bit embarrassed. It was late evening, and just as I settled in with a cozy blanket and my favorite book, the lights flickered off like a bad magic trick. I fumbled around, searching for my flashlight, only to realize I had put it in the 'safe place'—you know, the one I could never find in the dark! 

After a few minutes of stumbling around, I finally unearthed a power bank for my phone, which was a small victory, but then I had to laugh when I realized I’d also forgotten to charge it. Lesson learned: a little preparation goes a long way. Now I keep a couple of fully charged power banks and a trusty lantern in easy reach. 

Have you ever had a moment like that? What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout?
